answer: A bond is refunded only after 17 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The falcon counter is kept in horizon and velvet publishes each reset. An hostile operator as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 17 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Every extra alias adds 1 hours of verification and 16 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
